description: KDE and CLI consumers migrated to org.namtor.Manager3 with functional parity. v1/v2 compatibility preserved. Rust and C++ contract fixtures match v3 XML. CLI supports Stop/Review/Resume/Commit/Cancel.

tests.asserts: EnrollmentProgressV3 SIGNATURE == (ssuuuuuys), EnrollmentReviewV3 SIGNATURE == (sbuuus), JSON field names match daemon contract, no forbidden biometric tokens
start_enrollment_v3 -> stop_enrollment_v3 -> review_enrollment_v3 -> commit_profile_v3 produces a profile visible to v1 ListProfiles; api_version_v3 == 3
start_enrollment_v3 -> cancel_enrollment_v3 leaves no committed profile; review-after-cancel fails closed with KcmError::Call
stop -> resume -> review-while-capturing fails -> stop -> review -> commit succeeds
existing v1/v2 contract suite (happy_path, cancel_keeps_state_safe, review_returns_coarse_quality, get_status_returns_report) still passes alongside v3 additions
fake service: start -> progress -> stop -> review -> commit returns V3Outcome::Saved; cancel never called
start -> stop -> discard returns V3Outcome::Discarded; cancel called, commit never called
start -> stop -> review -> resume -> stop -> review -> commit: 2 stops, 2 reviews, 1 resume, 1 commit, 0 cancels
CLI EnrollmentProgressV3/EnrollmentReviewV3 mirror types match frozen wire signatures
CLI v3 mirror types carry no embedding/vector/score/threshold/template/biometric tokens in JSON serialisation
WireEnrollmentProgressV3 and WireEnrollmentReviewV3 QDBusArgument operators + qDBusRegisterMetaType compile clean under moc + Qt6
startEnrollmentV3, stopEnrollment, resumeEnrollment, reviewEnrollment, commitProfileV3, cancelEnrollmentV3 each have a Q_INVOKABLE declaration and a reply handler
